b29af8b06b.q: What is Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and how does it differ from traditional SEO?
b29af8b06b.a: Answer Engine Optimization focuses on optimizing for AI search responses rather than just traditional search engine rankings. While SEO was about getting found on page one of search engines, AEO ensures your business is cited in AI-generated answers. The fundamental SEO recipe still applies, but now businesses must optimize for how AI systems query, summarize, and judge website information.

85cdc9c4e6.q: What role do Google reviews play in AI recommendation algorithms for local businesses?
85cdc9c4e6.a: AI engines prioritize authentic, meaningful Google reviews with substantial content over high review counts with no detail. The responsiveness of business owners to reviews—acknowledging and taking action—is another critical data point. AI sees through artificially inflated review counts and values genuine customer engagement and business follow-up.
